hybrid_ablation.note: which action head is responsible for the collapse: hold three heads at the expert's choice, swap in the learned head(s)

expert_dist_dir_learned_spawn.comment: LEARNED SPAWN ALONE collapses the run

probe.reading: the learned spawn probability averages 0.23-0.29, i.e. BELOW the 0.5 decision threshold, so almost no spawn request is issued (0.2-0.4% of agent-ticks vs the expert's ~1.6-1.7%); the energy fraction is also ~40-45% below the expert's, so the reproduction gate is genuinely less often satisfied. Population dies of age with no heir chain.

knob_sweep.selected: SHIPPED = untuned gate threshold 0.50, cooldown 120 (no small-sample selection). The 0.20 threshold won on these 3 train seeds but did NOT transfer to the held-out eval seeds (mean 1307 vs 2569), so it is recorded as a negative result, not shipped.
